key_points: Nvidia's reported ~$19B vote of confidence is the one genuinely thesis-relevant item—it supports Intel's foundry/AI narrative and explains the pre-market rally.
New class-action alleging misleading disclosures on slowing PC business and AI positioning is a modest negative overhang, not thesis-changing on its own.
Most other headlines are technical/commentary noise (death cross, 'price to buy', oversold screens, AI fund blowup story).
Sector-wide AI/semi volatility and fund rebalancing (SOXX selling) drive near-term price swings more than Intel-specific fundamentals.
Net: mild positive skew on the Nvidia endorsement, but conviction is limited and the lawsuit plus weak PC backdrop cap upside.
